## Behavior

Describe the concrete trigger, previous behavior and resulting behavior. Keep the scope tied to borrower-level defaults, paired paths and empirical tail attribution.

## Evidence

Include a minimal synthetic example or an independently calculated expectation when behavior changes. Explain any intentional contract, compatibility or saved-evidence change; do not refresh expected outputs merely to make a verifier pass.

## Validation

List the commands run and their results using [the contribution guide](https://github.com/dev-belly/StressAtlas/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md). For documentation or configuration changes, record link/YAML checks instead of unrelated model runs. State checks that could not run and why.

## Data and boundaries

Confirm that added examples can be published and retain their source attribution. For numerical differences, include OS, NumPy/SciPy versions and driver fingerprint. State whether the report was generated locally or copied from the committed Linux demo.
